note: Routes that mutate (or read while authenticated) without an explicit scope or role gate. Seeded from the state on 2026-08-10 so the gate can only ratchet down. Remove an entry when the route gets its gate, and remove it when the route goes away, because an entry naming a file that no longer exists reads as a reviewed decision and is nothing of the sort. Never add one without a written reason and an approver. `pnpm check:route-scopes` names the entries that have gone stale under 'Already gated'.
